observation.command:
echo "=== 1. install.pl now locked (should show 'already installed') ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "install.pl http=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/install.pl
curl -s http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/install.pl | grep -oiE "alreadyinstalled[^<]*|bereits installiert|already installed" | head -2
echo "=== 2. index.pl login page ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "index.pl http=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/index.pl
echo "=== 3. static asset ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "static css http=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/static/css/qisutu.css
echo "=== 4. daemon process (as qisutu) ==="
ps -o user,pid,etime,cmd -p $(pgrep -f "perl /opt/qisutu/bin/qisutu-daemon" | head -1)
echo "=== 5. apache & mariadb ==="
pgrep -x apache2 | head -1 && echo "apache2: running"
mariadb-admin ping 2>&1
echo "=== 6. systemd unit state (only daemon should remain) ==="
ls /etc/systemd/system/ | grep -i qisutu
cat /run/qisutu/systemctl.state
echo "=== 7. install log tail ==="
tail -8 /opt/qisutu/var/log/install.log
echo "=== 8. release version ==="
grep "^version=" /opt/qisutu/release.conf
